sentences.text: Present:-

Ms. Pushpa Joshi, Senior Advocate assisted by Ms. Chetna
 Latwal and Ms. Nipush Mola Joshi, Advocates for the
 applicant.
Ms. Manisha Rana Singh, Aga for the State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)

Applicant Vishwajeet alias Jeet is in judicial custody Fir No.521 of 2023, dated 07.09.2023, under
Section 376 Ipc and Sections 5/6 of The Protection Of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012,
Police Station Rudrapur, District Udham Singh Nagar.
He has sought his release on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, on 22.07.2023, the victim had stomach ache, she was taken to the hospital.
It was revealed that she was pregnant.
She was then 17 years of age.
Subsequently, the foetus was aborted.
Despite being inquired, the victim did not reveal as to whose child was it.

Subsequently,
during investigation it was revealed that the applicant had established physical relations with the victim.
4. Learned Senior Counsel appearing for the applicant would submit that the victim was above 18 years of the age on the date when she had conceived.
It is argued that it is a case for bail.
5. It is the stage of bail.
Much of the discussion at this stage is to be avoided.

To the extent of appreciating the controversy the matter may be examined with the caveat that any observation made at this stage shall have no bearing at any subsequent stage of the case.

sentences.text: 6. In her examination the victim as PW1 has stated that the applicant had established physical relations with her in the year 2023.
The victim was examined in the year 2024, when she revealed her age as 19 years.

7. During the course of hearing, learned State counsel would submit that the DNA of the foetus was examined and it did not match with the applicant and the DNA report revealed that the applicant was not the biological father of the foetus.
8. Having considered, this Court is of the view that it is a case fit for bail and the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.

9. The bail application is allowed.
10. Let the applicant be released on bail, on his executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the court concerned.

(Ravindra Maithani, J.) 15.03.2024 Sanjay Vishwajeet Alias Jeet vs State Of Uttarakhand on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/195032160/
